aggregate_conservation_check.note: T1 gas rows: Σ allocated (space_heating+DHW) = Σ observed_gas × (share_h+share_d=1.0) × η=0.80, i.e. exactly 0.80× observed, by algebraic construction. The 20% difference is real fuel-to-delivered-heat efficiency loss (stack/excess-air), intentionally NOT stored as an end-use bucket. Recorded as a reproducibility receipt and sanity check that shares+η were applied as parameterized; not a statistical finding.

honest_limits: No invented confidence intervals: outputs carry evidence tier + method tag, not a CI.
Missing inputs produce null end-uses, never zero.
Campus/parent-child disaggregation is allocation-based (area-weighted), carried as flags disagg/ disagg_weight/ disagg_n from build_pilot.py; conservation checks vs LL84 property aggregates.
Site EUI out of physical plausibility (>9999 kBtu/ft2, e.g. data-entry outliers) kept as OBSERVED but flagged desc_outlier; not silently winsorized.
shares_parameterized_replacement_note: All shares are FIXED CONSTANTS (end-use split priors). They are deliberately parameterized here (not hardcoded) so the modeling workstream (DEV-alternative iterations, e.g. regression on LL84 fuels + heating-degree disaggregation) can replace them wholesale without touching pipeline logic. Each constant cites its source. These are priors, NOT per-building fits — no invented precision: every modeled output carries an evidence tier and 'model:additive-end-use-split' method tag.
